title: Conversation statuses
description: Your own status names on top of the base statuses (Open, Pending, Resolved), for example "In progress". Agents set them from the status picker in the conversation header.
forbidden: You do not have permission to view conversation statuses.
load_failed: Statuses could not be loaded. Refresh the page and try again.
empty_description: Add a status such as "In progress" to show which stage a conversation is at.
form.description: Agents see the name and color; the base category drives reports, SLA and automations.
form.name: Name
form.category_help: Conversations with this status count as this base status. Changing the category removes the custom status from conversations that no longer match.
